free_tier.stated: A free NAT IPv4 VPS obtained through a Telegram bot; the panel shows the IPv4 address, an SSH port, and a port list behind a SHOW button. [translated]

egress.terms: No traffic figure is stated in the write-ups.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: SSH to the shared IPv4 on the assigned port, plus a web panel.
chaining: none: the distribution host does not resolve, so no machine is issued and no endpoint exists.

limits.value: a fixed list of assignable ports
renewal required; interval not stated in what

binding_note: No byte cap is published, so nothing in the vocabulary fails at 1 TiB; the port list is the practical limit.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account is the only credential: log in through @vpslog_distribute_bot and receive a code.

reliability_note: Shared IPv4 with a restricted port list; nothing about durability is documented.
confidence_note: The distribution host answers a DNS failure, so the offer is dead; the other sources are from 2023 and describe the offer while it was live.

evidence.proved: Telegram-only signup, NAT IPv4 with a restricted port list, no traffic figure
the free NAT machines were handed out through a Telegram bot in 2023
the host distribute.vpslog.net does not resolve; a public DoH resolver answered NXDOMAIN for it and for vpslog.net
the distribution host does not resolve

notes: Dead: the distribution host distribute.vpslog.net does not resolve (DNS failure), so the free NAT VPS is no longer issued. Kept as the archetype of the Telegram-only free NAT VPS, where only a listed subset of ports of a shared IPv4 is forwarded; the write-ups date from 2023.

extras.wg_detail: Root on a NAT VPS with a published port list; WG would bind a listed port. The port list is the open question: only a subset of ports is usable.
extras.volume_stated: No traffic figure is stated in the write-ups.
